description: This Java source file defines the custom exception class 'InputRequiredException' used by the DatabaseUpdater component in the OpenMRS project. It signals that user input is required before proceeding with a database update, encapsulating a map of prompts to data types.

classes.name: InputRequiredException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating input is required for database updates, containing a map of prompts to data types.

classes.name: InputRequiredException.DATATYPE
classes.description: Enumeration of possible input data types: STRING, INTEGER, DOUBLE, DATE.

methods.name: InputRequiredException
methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with a map of required inputs.

methods.name: getRequiredInput
methods.description: Accessor method returning the map of prompts to data types.
